narrative: Material PL1__M52FB120 exhibits normal demand behavior over 106 working days with a mean of 1,515 units/day and a coefficient of variation of 0.33, indicating moderate but manageable variability. Lead times average 1.57 days but are classified as unstable (CV=0.59) due to occasional spikes near 3 days, which drives the safety stock requirement. The (r,Q) continuous review policy with SS=2,547 and Q=31,816 maintains 95% service level while reducing total annual cost by 38% versus the current SAP policy. The storage capacity constraint is satisfied with 75% utilization.
warnings: Lead time is unstable (CV=0.59); recommend quarterly supplier review
SAP safety stock (20,450) is 8x the recommended value (2,547); significant over-buffering detected

research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is continuous and normally distributed (CV=0.33) with near-100% non-zero days, making a continuous-review fixed-order-quantity model the natural fit. The (r,Q) policy minimizes total cost by balancing ordering frequency against holding cost while the reorder point ensures coverage through the variable lead-time period.
research_insights.boundary_risk: The storage capacity of 45,810 units limits the maximum post-replenishment stock to SS+Q=34,363 units (75% utilization). The EOQ-derived quantity falls within bounds, so the cap does not bind and no service degradation occurs.
